get.description: Liveness probe: confirms the process is up. Does not check dependencies.

post.description:
Redact, extract (LLM + rules), ground, route and persist one note.

Synchronous: the request waits for the LLM (~6 s on the dev laptop). A job queue is
future work. If the LLM is down the note is still saved, with baseline flags.

Approve, edit or reject every pending flag of a note, atomically, and optionally
escalate it to a care manager. One `review_decision` audit event per flag, plus a
`review_escalated` event.

get.description: The most recently saved rota (the prototype plans one synthetic day).

post.description:
Plan one day: OR-Tools VRPTW (+ two-phase continuity if the weight is > 0), with
reasons for every assignment and every unassigned visit. Synchronous (10-60 s).

get.description:
Where the run's carers start and its visits are, for the map.

Runs don't store locations (data minimisation, Step 2.6), so a map is only available
when the run's input hash matches the committed synthetic sample day. A real deployment
would read locations from the client record under its own access control.
Carers ranked by risk (highest first), each with its three largest factors.

Every factor's contribution (log-odds; they add up to the score), with support
actions for the provider-side factors that raise risk.
